raw_line: Furina Freeze Team (Furina — Skirk — Escoffier — Shenhe)

raw_line: Hypercarry Team with Furina (Furina — Xilonen — Kazuha — Wriothesley)
description: This is a Hypercarry team composition for Furina. She is a staple buffer for these type of composition, but do remember that she requires a Healer to properly function.
